description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I (Lightning)] and [Lightning Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I (Lightning)
description.text: Lightning abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Lightning abilities trigger 2 additional times, critical chance =50%/100% for Lightning abilities after casting 1/2+ Lightning abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Lightning Mode II (Lightning)], removes [Dual Awoken Lightning Mode I (Lightning)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Lightning Mode II (Lightning)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Lightning abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for Lightning abilities, increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3
